title: FDA Drug Safety Communication: Clostridium difficile associated diarrhea can be associated with stomach acid drugs known as proton pump inhibitors (PPIs)
journal: US Food and Drug Administration, Drug Safety Communication, 8 February 2012
result: Review of Adverse Event Reporting System cases and 28 observational studies in 26 publications: 23 studies showed a higher risk of C. difficile infection or disease with PPI exposure, mostly 1.4 to 2.75 times that without exposure. Many reported patients were elderly, had chronic conditions or took broad-spectrum antibiotics; data on dose and duration were limited. The weight of evidence suggests a positive association.
